stem.en: During the 2025 floods in Punjab, what did murky standing water cause?

feedback.en: Yes. Standing water spread disease and raised sanitation concerns.

text.en: The heavy monsoon rains over Punjab

feedback.en: No. Rain came first. Standing water came after it.

text.en: The rise of the rivers before the rains

feedback.en: No. The rivers were high before any standing water.
No. These are weather systems, not an effect of the flood.

explanation.en: Murky standing water caused health problems, including the spread of waterborne diseases and sanitation concerns.

hints.en: Think about drinking water and clean surroundings.
This effect is about people's health.
